stories.story_fr: Le bénéfice net a augmenté à 232,0 M$ contre 189,1 M$ l'année précédente.
stories.story_en: Net income rose to $232.0 million from $189.1 million year over year.
stories.quote: net income of $232.0 million ($1.41 per diluted common share) for the first quarter of 2026, compared to net income of $189.1 million ($1.06 per diluted common share) for the first quarter of 2025

stories.story_fr: Rachat d'actions de 400 M$ et dividendes de 78,4 M$.
stories.story_en: Share repurchases of $400 million and dividends of $78.4 million.
stories.quote: approximately $400 million of shares repurchased, and $78.4 million of common stock dividends

stories.story_fr: Ratio de capital basé sur le risque de 460 % bien au-dessus des objectifs.
stories.story_en: Risk-based capital ratio of approximately 460% well above target levels.
stories.quote: weighted average risk-based capital ratio of approximately 460 percent, well above target levels

stories.story_fr: Croissance des ventes de 14,4 % et des primes de 3,9 %.
stories.quote: 14.4 percent sales growth and 3.9 percent premium growth on a constant currency basis
